mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index crosses above 240, it signals rising inflation expectations, prompting investors to anticipate higher interest rates, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 240 within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates and rise in RSAFS demand spending signal a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS <1% and RSAFS >450,000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle demand expansion, high GDPC1 demand growth and low unemployment (UNRATE) signal robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle demand expansion periods, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) when GDPC1 >17000 and UNRATE <4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong demand growth (RSAFS >450M) combined with ultra-low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS <1%) signals a powerful economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS >450 and FEDFUNDS <1% but 60-day returns not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS >145,000) alongside falling unemployment (UNRATE <4.5%) indicates a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS >145k and UNRATE <4.5% but 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the INDPRO supply index suggests lower inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases but 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% but SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) or in tightening periods returns are positive.
